info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Antlerit Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Antlerit Battery Detail Management API allows users to create and manage detailed information about the Antlerit battery catalog. This API is essential for businesses that need to maintain an up-to-date inventory of battery specifications, features, and availability. Typical consumers include inventory managers and product teams who can use this functionality to enhance product offerings and streamline catalog updates. Operations include adding new battery details that can improve customer insights and purchasing decisions.

post.description: This operation allows users to submit detailed information regarding the Antlerit battery, enabling efficient processing and response.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary details for the creation or update of an Antlerit battery. The payload should conform to the specified schema in order to ensure the correct processing of the request.
